proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5239 jīva explicitly includes Nepali jiu “body, life”, Oriya jī “heart” and the addendum’s Western Pahari jiu “mind, heart, person”. The survey jiv/jiu body/heart polysemy therefore has primary comparative support. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
